title: Observability: fd-type mismatch returns -ENODEV without log in 7 handlers
description: Seven ioctl handlers (ioctl_set_iv, ioctl_gen_iv, ioctl_set_aad, ioctl_get_tag, ioctl_set_tag, ioctl_finalize, ioctl_reset) all contain the check 'if (state->fd_type != CRYPTO2DEV_FDTYPE_OPERATION) { ret = -ENODEV; goto out; }' with no log before the return. When an app calls SET_IV on an UNSET fd (e.g. forgot to call INIT first) or on a KEY fd (wrong fd type), it receives -ENODEV with zero context. Support engineer cannot distinguish: fd never initialized, fd is a KEY fd, device not present. Trigger: call any of the 7 ioctls on an UNSET or KEY fd. Bad outcome: -ENODEV returned silently, no log entry in ring buffer. Fix: add pr_info_ratelimited before each -ENODEV goto, logging state->fd_type and the ioctl name. Locations: crypto2dev_fd.c lines 884, 948, 1032, 1090, 1151, 1499, 1585.
